Spiderman icon

Branding·by @exteedesign·2026-08-28·inspora page·original post

What it is

Static render: Spider-Man iOS app icon - glossy black eye frame with a reflective white lens over a red webbed, diagonally-ribbed squircle, presented in a grid of grey placeholder icons.

Media

Frame-by-frame

image
Centered squircle app icon: red base with fine diagonal ribbing and white web lines radiating; the mask eye sits center as a raised black gloss shape with a white/silver lens (soft top-light gradient, specular streak); surrounding greyed placeholder icons fade out of focus. Big soft drop shadow under the eye element.

Build prompt

Rebuild this static comp 1:1, pixel-faithful: a Spider-Man iOS app icon - glossy black eye frame with a reflective white lens over a red webbed, diagonally-ribbed squircle, presented in a grid of grey placeholder icons.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind (or pure SVG). Layered gradients, inner/outer shadows, specular highlights - this is a rendering exercise, no motion.

## Scene
Centered squircle app icon: red base with fine diagonal ribbing and white web lines radiating from behind the mask. Center: the eye emblem as a raised black gloss shape holding a white/silver lens (soft top-light gradient, specular streak). A big soft drop shadow under the eye element. Surrounding: greyed placeholder app icons, slightly out of focus, forming the grid.

## Motion spec
None - static render.

## Calibration
- Gloss comes from layered gradients + one tight specular streak, not blur.
- Ribbing is fine and diagonal, low contrast - it should reward zooming, not shout.
- The eye element casts the only strong shadow; the squircle itself sits flatter.

## Reduced motion
N/A - static comp.

## Don't miss
- The lens reads as glass (silver-white with a light direction), not flat white.
- Web lines radiate consistently from one point behind the mask.
- Placeholder icons are defocused/neutral so the hero icon pops by contrast.
